overall_summary: The channel heavily relies on 'self respect' and smartphone interaction themes (chats, pins, names, lists). While view counts are generally low across all videos, topics related to digital boundary-setting (removing pins, hiding status, deleting chat lists) slightly outperform abstract emotional topics like late-night thoughts or unrequited love in this small sample size.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'rwOUYo_hayQ' (41 views), 'AfaLxMy6FMY' (41 views), and 'Y4finYMxnIU' (32 views) used specific phone interface actions as hooks.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on micro-actions related to smartphones and chat interfaces tied to self-respect.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'uIbMpCjVutQ' (6 views) and 'WhJ-VwRa3Rg' (8 views) using general late-night or tea/weather metaphors underperformed compared to tangible phone actions.
weak_patterns.action: Reduce abstract atmospheric hooks and root every story in a concrete, physical digital action.
